horizon_rationale: Raw official motion-planning mean length is 77.976, maximum 103. Use a fixed 200-step horizon for BC, all SAC variants and U0, chosen before learned-policy scores.
termination_protocol: Continue after task success; stop episodes at time limit. Preserve raw task termination and truncation labels; effective task terminal mask is false under this continuing-task protocol, and time limits bootstrap from final observation.
conversion: Official CPU action conversion with first-state recording repair; then true GPU action replay from initial state only. Never force each timestep's state.
failed_replay_policy: Retain all raw failures; only final-success GPU-replayed episodes enter the shared BC/expert dataset, matching upstream expert-quality filtering. Log excluded IDs, and split whole eligible episodes 80/20 using seed 42. Never select using policy test performance.
sac_gamma_note: Explicit CLI override of upstream 0.8, fixed before all A/B/C/U0 runs for the sparse 200-step protocol.
reset_revision_reason: F-E0-004: stale GPU contact observed in 1/1312 initial observations of SAC A-full-001. Rebuild scene on full reset as already done for BC/evaluation and corrected demonstration replay. A-full-001 retained as historical protocol1; rerun A/B/C with protocol2.
